name: Token Latency Fairness: Performance Isolation for Multi-Tenant LLM Serving (arXiv 2609.18112)
notes: arXiv cats cs.DC/cs.LG, no venue claim in comment. Introduces a delta-token fairness guarantee: if a well-behaved client's token takes d time units in isolation, it is produced within d + delta under multi-tenant execution. Authors include Dev Bali, Soujanya Ponnapalli, Yichuan Wang, Natacha Crooks, Scott Shenker, Matei Zaharia.
